title: The Hunt Club
summary: Young diablerists who stalk elder Kindred across the British Isles.

claims.text: For about thirty years, Kindred of the sixth to ninth generations have vanished across the British Isles, leaving bloodless remains and hunting tokens such as a riding crop, a red hunting cap or a fox tail in their havens.

The Hunt Club is a loose coterie of brash young Cainites who commit diablerie both for the power of elder blood and for the thrill of chasing the most dangerous prey there is; lately they warn victims in advance, and their chosen quarry keeps getting older.
No formal Blood Hunt has been called in London, where Mithras is missing, but every other fief and coterie in the isles treats membership as a capital crime.
A persistent rumour ties the club to Count Zaroff, a Caitiff and former Russian big-game hunter under Blood Hunt in much of Europe, unseen since being driven out of Berlin.
